messages:
maria: Quick sync — we want to add automated eval gates for design partner (DP) invites. Goal: catch regressions early and define SLA/exit criteria. Thoughts?
kevin: Clarify scope — model-quality automated gates only, or integration + prompt-set checks too?
maria: Both. Automated metrics for nightly evals + a small manual review loop for edge failures. Need clear thresholds and response timelines.
samir: Can thresholds be partner-adjustable? Some partners will require stricter gates.
ashley: We can support per-partner thresholds. Suggest automated scoring + change-delta alerts. Example heuristics: pass if quality_score >= 0.92 and delta <= 2.5% vs baseline. :ballot_box_with_check:
kevin: Recommend auto-rollback to fallback model when regression > 3% on primary metric, plus canary rollout (5% traffic) while we investigate. Need an owner for each metric.
maria: Owners: ashley -> eval infra & scoring, kevin -> rollout + fallback wiring, samir -> onboarding + partner comms. ops-bot will create alerts.
ops-bot: incident: eval-gate-fail detected for dp/partner-alpha — quality_delta 4.2% — INC-2024-1123 created.
jordan: From partner ops: partners want a 2-week notice before full rollback and example failing prompts when we alert. Also visibility into daily eval dashboard.
maria: Proposed playbook steps: 1) build eval harness + canonical prompt sets (ashley) 2) onboarding invite + opt-in language + incentives (samir + jordan) 3) SLA: 48h triage for alerts, 5 business day remediation window before escalation/rollback 4) automation: nightly evals + canary (5%) + auto-fallback. OK?
kevin: I can wire canary + auto-fallback. Implementation estimate: ~2 sprints (development + infra). Also we should include latency & token-cost drift as metrics.
ashley: I'll draft canonical prompt sets and automated scoring pack. Quick snippet for eval runner:```
# run nightly eval for DP set
run_eval --set dp_alpha_prompts --metrics quality_score,latency,token_cost --baseline v1.8
```
samir: I'll draft invite copy, plus compensation and opt-out flow. Will include explicit exit criteria and examples.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate into a short DP Eval Gates playbook and add to roadmap under "DP-eval-gates". Target: share draft by Friday for review. Any blockers?
jordan: No blockers from partners; they want dashboard access + sample failing prompts.
kevin: Also add a metric for latency regressions (p95) — partners care about UX.
maria: Noted — adding latency p95 and token_cost_per_1k_tokens to the gate. Closing loop here; will ping when doc is live.
